entities.name: Alexandre Noël Charles Acloque
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexandre Noël Charles Acloque (1871–1941) was a French botanist who was an expert in lichens. Acloque was broadly interested in natural history and wrote books on the flora and fauna (insects) of France.
